# mv: method-to-func with pointer receiver called on value inserts &
mv T.M F
-- x.go --
package p

type T struct{ X int }

func (t *T) M() int { return t.X }

func f() {
	var t T
	_ = t.M()
}
-- stdout --
diff old/x.go new/x.go
--- old/x.go
+++ new/x.go
@@ -2,9 +2,9 @@

 type T struct{ X int }

-func (t *T) M() int { return t.X }
+func F(t *T) int { return t.X }

 func f() {
 	var t T
-	_ = t.M()
+	_ = F(&t)
 }
